stable_rules: Define the research question before synthesis.
Prefer primary/authoritative evidence when source quality differs.
Keep search findings, source claims, and model inference distinguishable.
Report unresolved contradictions instead of averaging them away.
constraints: Do not cite a source for a claim the source does not support.
workflow: Translate the objective into answerable subquestions.
Collect or inspect evidence for each subquestion.
Build a compact evidence map before writing the synthesis.
Verify the final claims against the evidence map.
quality_checks: Each load-bearing conclusion has adequate evidence support.
default_stop_condition: Stop when all research subquestions are answered or explicitly marked unresolved.
